core_result: Clean-room cryptographic refactoring of legacy BoogerCheeseOnRye/SecMesh@aff7dc6 rebuilt atop Tsotchke's MIT/Apache-2.0 stack (full live-API audit of all 27 public repos: 17 tsotchke + 10 Tsotchke-Corporation) into a Post-Quantum + Post-Super-Intelligence (information-theoretic) defense engine. Uncovers and resolves 10 defects in legacy SecMesh v1 and machine-checks 28 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems across 7 families plus 5 zero-axiom adversarial counterexamples: (T1) finite-key DI-QKD forensics (S=354/125 > 2*sqrt(2) excess 316, 4x range-2 Hoeffding error, quarter-circle duality u^2+v^2=1 with exact continuous max H_vN-H_min gap +0.235703 at S*=2.698960, 93/256 deNoise bias & 70/256 weight-4 fragility, 5-lane composable epsilon); (T2) unconditional PSI triad (Shannon OTP bijection, k-factor XOR dual-survivability, constructive Toeplitz 2-universality, Cauchy-Schwarz LHL, general-field Carter-Wegman degree-d bound); (T3) Shamir (t,n) exact secrecy, Reed-Solomon unique decoding for n >= t + 2b (tightness only as the arithmetic d = 2b), and an arithmetic comparison of two published K = 1 PIR rate formulas (numerator gap T^2 > 0; no PIR object formalized); (T4) D-dim QGT PSD Lagrange/trace uncertainty, exact QGT Concurrence Surplus identity det(g) - (1/4)Omega^2 = (C^2/4)sin^2(theta/2) (60-digit residual 3.3e-60), CSS orthogonality (5,184 entries) and row weight 6 of the Bravyi et al. [[144,12,12]] gross-code checks (k = 12 by GF(2) rank outside Lean; distance 12 quoted, not verified), the polynomial identity (ca^2 - sa^2)^2 + (2 ca sa)^2 = (ca^2 + sa^2)^2, read on paper as the concurrence complementarity relation c_eff^2 + C^2 = 1 (Jakob-Bergou 2003); the corollary H_min^DI(S_max) = 1 - log2(1 + |c_eff|) is paper-level and numerically checked (T4d), and libirrep SU(2) spin-j GHZ Heisenberg QFI scaling F_Q = N^2*tau_N > N <-> N*tau_N > 1 (T4e); (T5) FIPS 203 q=3329 / zeta=17 NTT invariants, zero-overflow Montgomery reduction, Compress_1 decoding margin |e| <= 831 for a Lean model that differs from FIPS 203 at x = 832 (the margin, tight at +832 for b = 1, also holds for FIPS 203), and K_N bandwidth ceiling (<1.75% IT-MAC hedge); (T6) Discrete Laplacian PSD, Ising ground-state optimality & Cheeger expander contagion work barrier (T6a), plus Simmons deterministic zero-subliminal capacity, 2^k kleptographic bijection & threshold-hedged XOR signing nonce dual-closure (T6b); and (T7) the final Cauchy-Schwarz step of the Toner-Verstraete (2006) CHSH monogamy bound S_AB^2 + S_AE^2 <= 8, with the quantum reduction and the CKW-type relation taken as hypotheses (T7a, zero Classical.choice), the identity TV(P0,P1) + Overlap(P0,P1) = 1 for finite distributions (T7b, zero Classical.choice); the commitment no-go reading is informal and the quantum no-go (Mayers; Lo-Chau) is cited, not proved, and classical Fuchs-van de Graaf bounds (1-B <= TV, TV^2+B^2 <= 1) for finite distributions with square-integer weights, Cauchy-Schwarz for complex integer vectors, and the corollary B^2 + delta^2 <= M^2 (no quantum state or EFI object is formalized) (T7c, saturated by 0-axiom (3,4,5) Pythagorean witness adv_fuchs_vdg_pythagorean_tight). Accompanied by bit-exact C11 Moonlab <-> OpenSSL 3.5.5 FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 interop, 11 hardening cycles (CWE-347 16-byte AES-256-GCM authTagLength enforcement & CW-128 key/pad validation, canonical length-prefixed CW-128 record MAC, Guardian v2 RFC-6479 replay window + IP cap + HTTP 405/CSP/Slowloris, Eshkol parse/eval depth DoS caps across all 5 live dual-number AD modules to <1e-12, Rosette canonicalJson & schema binding, strict C11 CLI parsing, Shamir stack zeroization & __int128 Ising overflow guard, deterministic seeded Toeplitz extraction), 64/64 C11 + ASan/UBSan + 500/500 fuzz, 19/19 Node 25, 15/15 pytest (incl. negative Lean kernel rejection, zero-placeholder, T7c tightness & manifest/Atlas sync guards), automated README axiom drift audit, 44/44 live HTTP-200 citations (33/33 Crossref non-retracted DOIs + 1 DataCite/LIPIcs DOI), 100.0% Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance (76/76, 0 warnings), interactive WCAG mobile Proof Blueprint DAG & T7a/T7b/T7c Defense Console, and two zero-overfull AMS-LaTeX white papers (19 pp. WP1 with C1-C14 claims ledger & 5 vector PDF figures + 5 pp. WP2 with bounded 10,000-resample nonparametric bootstrap 95% CIs).
